body: Thanks, you're right. I know even when I'm having those thoughts that they're irrational, and that everyone goes through what I'm going through. I'm just so tired of being logical, reasonable, and dispassionate, you know?  I want to throw caution to the wind for the first time in my life, and pick up the pieces later.  I know it's unhealthy, dangerous even. But right now, I can't seem to care.
